//Maxio: Maxio Advanced Billing settings for the recurring-subscription endpoints.
ApiKey and Subdomain are secrets and are intentionally left empty here: supply them through
dotnet user-secrets (development) or the environment/secret store of the host.
BaseUrl is an optional override; when set it is used verbatim instead of deriving the address
from Subdomain and Environment (US -> https://{site}.chargify.com, EU -> https://{site}.ebilling.maxio.com).
PaymentCollectionMethod defaults to 'remittance' because eShopOnWeb subscribes shoppers without
capturing a payment method; switch it to 'automatic' once payment profiles are collected, or
leave it empty to fall back to the Maxio site's own default.
